data.mask: reuse common_complete_training_rows.parquet exactly; no feature or row regeneration
data.purge: reuse the ten saved folds; every training label availability is no later than the earliest validation nominal decision

historical_reuse_review.base70_b0_cv_history: only selected iteration recovered from saved boosters and OOF; full history was not persisted before the post-fit NameError
historical_reuse_review.reason: Existing seed-stability/FULL_FEATURES fits fixed 31 rounds without early stopping; B0 summary lacks full history after a post-fit NameError, so the saved 31-tree boosters cannot verify 500-round/patience-50 selection. The control is rerun for all three seeds.

inactive_randomness_unchanged: inactive because current GBDT/binary settings do not use them

pre_fit_protocol_revision.reason: pre-fit serialization validation; no model fits or study database existed

study.objective_aligned_callback: utils.cv_objective.ObjectiveAlignedCVCallback; trial=None; same callback controls stopping and ranking
study.sampler: fixed balanced strength-2 4-level orthogonal-array subset; randomized order seed 20261019; all 31 candidate configurations frozen before fitting
study.seed_level_score: minimum over iterations of mean ten-fold unweighted binary log-loss + 0.5 * population standard deviation across folds
study.tie_break: lowest trial number among equal scores
study.trial_score: arithmetic mean of the three seed-level scores; no seed selection or probability averaging
